## Done: shared foundation for `cart/editor/`

Extracted the mock god-file's types/data/pure-helpers region (lines 1-1112 of `cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/index.tsx`) into organized multi-export `.ts` files. No cross-cart imports — everything is cloned. Components (line 1114+) were left untouched, as were `index.tsx`/`PlayRoute.tsx`/`EditorRoute.tsx`.

### File list + exports (for briefing extraction workers)

**`cart/editor/theme.ts`** (expanded in place) — `EDITOR_COLORS` (now the full 49-token mock palette: added `track, knob, onTrack, offTrack, offKnob, valText, valNum, compileBg, compileBgHover, stageGridBg, stageTile, stageTileBorder, stageBlock, stageBlockBorder, stageSelect, stageBadgeEdge, stageBadgeText, miniMapBg, miniMapGrid, miniShape, miniShapeBorder`), `EDITOR_STYLES` (unchanged — already matched the mock exactly).

**`cart/editor/workspace.cls.ts`** (new, verbatim clone) — `C` (the classifiers), `accentFor`. All `HW_*` class names preserved (HW_App through HW_HistoryMeta). Only the header was repointed to `EDITOR_COLORS`/`EDITOR_STYLES` via `setTokens`/`setStyleTokens`.

**`cart/editor/data/types.ts`** — types only: `Menu, LibraryTab, ViewMode, ContentFolderId, Command, BuildNote, BuildThread, Asset, AssetOverride, MaterialSource, ModelAtlas, ModelPaintVariant, ModelPackage, Rgb, ColorStudioMaterialKey, ShaderSlot, ShaderMaterial, PaletteSet, ContentNode, WorldObject, HistoryEvent, MockState`. (imports the 3 explorer types from `./fileExplorer`.)

**`cart/editor/data/catalog.ts`** — `CORE_MATERIALS, BUILD_ASSETS, PROP_ASSETS, MATERIAL_SOURCES, GENERATED_MATERIAL_COUNT, ASSET_PAGE_SIZE, MATERIAL_PAGE_SIZE, clampChannel, shadeHex, variantColor, makeGeneratedMaterials, ASSETS, MATERIAL_ASSET_COUNT, MODEL_PACKAGES, MODEL_PACKAGE_COUNT, applyAssetOverride, applyAssetOverrides, assetById, assetPageSizeFor`.

**`cart/editor/data/commands.ts`** — `MENUS, MENU_DROPDOWN_WIDTH, MENU_LEFT_BASE, MENU_LEFT_STEP, MENU_STAGE_GUTTER, COMMANDS, commandById, menuDropdownLeft, activeMenuFor`.

**`cart/editor/data/content.ts`** — `DOMAINS, RIGHT_PANES, CONTENT_TREE, SNAP_MODES, FLOORS, PRESETS, tabForContentFolder, folderForAsset, contentFolderLabel, isMaterialFolder, isModelFolder, modelPackagesForFolder, exactModelForFolder, assetMatchesContentFolder, countAssetsForFolder, rankAssets, selectedObject, panelModeFor`.

**`cart/editor/data/colorStudio.ts`** — `QUALITY_LABELS, SHADER_MATERIALS, COLOR_LIBRARY_SETS, clamp01, rgbToCss, rgbToVec3, mixRgb, complementRgb, colorStudioMaterial, colorStudioOverrideKey, bakedSlotRgb, resolvedSlotColor, materialPreviewCells, slotAssistColors`.

**`cart/editor/data/telemetry.ts`** — `editTimingFor, editSamples, average, percentile, editTelemetry, formatMs`.

**`cart/editor/data/journal.ts`** — `BUILD_NOTES, BUILD_THREADS, ACTIVE_BUILD`.

**`cart/editor/data/initialState.ts`** — `INITIAL_OBJECTS, INITIAL_HISTORY, initialState`.

**`cart/editor/data/fileExplorer.ts`** (verbatim clone of the mock's `fileExplorerData.ts`) — types `ExplorerFolderId, ExplorerFileKind, ExplorerModelPreview, ExplorerFolder, ExplorerFile, ExplorerHistoryEntry, ExplorerDirectoryHistoryEntry`; consts `EXPLORER_FOLDERS, EXPLORER_FILES, INITIAL_EXPLORER_HISTORY, INITIAL_EXPLORER_DIRECTORY_HISTORY`; functions `explorerFileById, explorerFolderLabel, explorerFileIcon, explorerMatchesFolder, explorerSearchText`.

### Two decisions worth flagging to workers
- **`HistoryEvent` lives in `data/types.ts`, not `data/telemetry.ts`** (the deliverable note listed it under telemetry). It's referenced by `MockState`, so keeping it with the other types avoids duplication. `telemetry.ts` imports it as a type. Components should import `HistoryEvent` from `data/types`.
- **`fileExplorer.ts`** had to be cloned even though it wasn't in the named deliverable list — `MockState` and `initialState()` depend on its types and seed-history consts. `FileExplorerDialog.tsx` (a component) was NOT cloned; that's an extraction worker's job and it will import from `data/fileExplorer`.

Inter-file dependency note (no cycles): `content.ts` → `catalog.ts` + `commands.ts` + `initialState.ts`; `initialState.ts` → `catalog.ts` + `fileExplorer.ts`; all → `types.ts`.
